input: Build a morning routine that sticks for real

gold.taskTitle: Build a Morning Routine That Actually Sticks
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to design and consistently maintain a personalized morning routine that becomes a lasting habit.

questions.title: What time do you need to be done by morning?
questions.description: Understand the hard deadline that anchors the routine, such as a work start time or school drop-off.

questions.title: What time are you realistically waking up right now?
questions.description: Establish the current baseline wake time to gauge how much the routine needs to shift or fit.

questions.title: Which activities do you most want included?
questions.description: Identify the specific habits the user wants to build in, such as exercise, journaling, meditation, or a healthy breakfast.

questions.title: What has made past morning routines fall apart?
questions.description: Uncover the specific obstacles or failure points that have prevented consistency before.

questions.title: How many days a week should this routine apply?
questions.description: Clarify whether this is a seven-day routine or limited to weekdays, with different rules for weekends.

questions.title: Do you live alone or share mornings with others?
questions.description: Determine whether kids, a partner, or roommates affect timing, noise, or shared responsibilities in the morning.

questions.title: Are you a slow starter or do you hit the ground running?
questions.description: Understand the user's natural energy profile in the morning to sequence routine tasks in a realistic order.
